name: Tidio
tagline: Live chat and an AI agent for customer conversations
description: Tidio combines AI and human conversations on one platform, with the Lyro AI Agent answering common questions and no-code Flows for conversion paths.
features: Lyro AI Agent answers common questions and performs recurring tasks
Flows: no-code conversion paths triggered at key moments
useCases: Handing conversations to a human agent
strengths: A free plan and a 7-day trial without a card (per the page)
Plan limits are stated as numbers of billable conversations
limitations: Annual prices were not stated on the page we read
Lyro AI conversations are sold as an add-on beyond a small free allowance

free.details: Free: 50 billable conversations and 10 seats; the first 50 Lyro AI conversations are free (lifetime); the first 100 visitors reached via Flows are free.

pricing.trial: A 7-day free trial is offered without a credit card; the account then downgrades to Free unless upgraded.

plans.name: Starter
plans.billing: Shown on the monthly view; the annual price was not stated

plans.name: Plus
plans.note: Starts at $300 per month plus monthly usage; custom conversations and seats

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: Contact for pricing; from 3,000 Lyro AI conversations

plans.name: Lyro AI Agent add-on
plans.note: Starts at $32.50 per month for 50 Lyro AI conversations

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. A toggle offers annual billing with 2 months free, but annual prices were not stated.
